statement: Execution ledger for the T1J render-only worksheet export. Only checks listed under commands and cases were actually run; mutation controls are worker-authored and are not the Local independent probe.

commands.command: cvf-web/node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config .cvf/runtime/nis-t1j-worker-20261006/vitest.scratch.config.js (scratch harness capture-legacy.test.ts against unmodified producers)
node_modules/.bin/eslint --max-warnings=0 on the four changed source and test paths
scratch vitest harness worksheet-snapshot.test.ts rendering the final renderer

toolAccess: Read-only directory junction cvf-web/node_modules to the main checkout installed dependencies (git-ignored); no install, no network, no npm lifecycle, no build.

IntentSpecConfirmation.test.tsx: offers the worksheet only for a current candidate and exports the exact bytes beside the JSON file
leaves the existing JSON download, readback and confirmation behavior unchanged beside the new control
shows bilingual labels and a Vietnamese worksheet when the language is vi
cleans up the object URL and reports failure without implying a save
removes the worksheet when the reviewer, review content or language changes, and never exports an older candidate
blocks a worksheet from an out-of-order generation after the reviewer changes
does not offer a worksheet for an unacknowledged review
intent-spec-confirmation.test.ts: binds exact source SHA, bytes, revision, language, reviewer and time, and keeps the draft verbatim
preserves Unicode, multiline and CRLF draft content and survives backtick runs in the draft
is deterministic, leaves the candidate untouched and uses LF for its own lines
leaves every manual section UNFILLED and invents no requirement, readiness or policy
does not extract from the draft: different drafts yield identical instructions and sections
rejects a candidate whose bytes cannot be read instead of rendering a partial worksheet
keeps candidate bytes identical to the controls captured from the unmodified preimage

REQ-1-source-binding.tests: lib T1J: binds exact source SHA, bytes, revision, language, reviewer and time; Unicode/CRLF/backtick fence

REQ-1-unfinished-manual.tests: lib T1J: six UNFILLED sections, no invented requirement, readiness or policy; different drafts give identical instructions
REQ-1-unfinished-manual.disclosure: Absence checks are literal-pattern checks on the instruction text, not a semantic proof.

REQ-1-v1-v2-bytes.tests: lib T1J: candidate bytes equal the controls captured from the unmodified preimage
REQ-1-v1-v2-bytes.disclosure: Three controls: v1 en 3980 bytes, v2 en 6136 bytes, v1 vi 4693 bytes.

REQ-1-unreadable-candidate.tests: lib T1J: rejects unreadable candidate bytes

REQ-2-export-current-bytes.tests: component T1J: exports exact bytes beside the JSON file; worksheet SHA equals the SHA of the exported JSON blob

REQ-2-invalidation-race.tests: component T1J: reviewer, review content and language changes remove the worksheet; out-of-order generation blocked; unacknowledged review offers none

REQ-2-failure-cleanup.tests: component T1J: click failure revokes the URL; createObjectURL failure revokes nothing; both report no saved confirmation

REQ-2-existing-lifecycle.tests: component T1J: JSON download and readback unchanged; unchanged server test file 28/28
REQ-2-existing-lifecycle.disclosure: Server test file was run, not edited.

REQ-2-bilingual.tests: component T1J: vi labels, vi status text and vi worksheet
REQ-2-bilingual.disclosure: jsdom rendering only; no browser or novice-user evidence.

mutationControls.disclosure: No-op for the fixtures because no fixture draft has edge whitespace, so this was not a discriminating control; no test was added for it.

mutationControls.change: carriage returns stripped from the verbatim draft
worksheet path no longer revokes its object URL
sources restored byte-identical after each mutation (sha256 compared)

diagnosticRuns.note: vite-node and tsx are not installed; replaced with a scratch vitest config
scratch vitest config attempts failed on defineConfig import, relative include glob and an unterminated string in my own scratch harness before the capture ran; no tracked file was affected
first CR-strip mutation attempts used shell-escaped backslashes and produced a syntax error (no tests ran); redone with String.fromCharCode(13)

notRun: Full package tests, API route tests, browser or Playwright, npm run build, npm lifecycle scripts, provider or network calls, the Local independent probe (PENDING_REVIEWER_EXECUTION), reviewer-fast and pre-commit gates.
